22,604 km of Spanish railway, drawn on the year each section actually opened, from 1848 onwards.

Watch the Iberian-gauge network spread out of Madrid, watch narrow-gauge lines fill the north, and watch high-speed track appear on top of it all.

📊 See the Spanish rail network build itself from 1848 to 2022 in this animated map, 4,472 sections placed at their real opening dates and coloured by gauge: Iberian, narrow and high speed. Explore how Madrid's radial network took shape, and how the AVE was laid over it.

Source: Railways of Spain GIS — Esteban-Oliver & Martí-Henneberg, DOI 10.34810/DATA917 (CC BY 4.0). Land: Natural Earth (public domain).
